registeredConsumers.purpose: Finance-owned one-to-one Party subledger account identity; no balance or ledger data.
Maps versioned Persons API registration and quick-registration response contracts to application commands and responses; transports PartyId and masked duplicate candidates without owning Party data.

Protected GET Party details and canonical feature-gated natural/legal registration routes. All writes perform duplicate resolution, require persons.read and persons.create, and derive actor from a validated IdentityAccess session.
Authenticated HTTP adapter transports opaque PartyId path/query values and versioned masked Party detail/quick-registration contracts; it does not own Party data or authorize sensitive reads.
WPF client uses opaque PartyId only to present authenticated quick-registration outcomes and masked duplicate candidates; it does not own Party records or perform persistence.
Published reference to Finance-owned Party account identity.
Finance participant for controlled Party merge; preserves ledger history and blocks dual-account conflicts.
Transaction-bound idempotent provisioning of Finance-owned Party account identity.

mergeClassificationDefinitions.PERSISTED_ACTIVE_REFERENCE: The source persists an active PartyId reference; its owning module must declare an explicit merge participant or a blocking disposition.
mergeClassificationDefinitions.CONTRACT_ONLY_REFERENCE: The source publishes a typed PartyId reference but does not persist a runtime row; the contract itself is not rewritten by merge.
mergeClassificationDefinitions.NON_PERSISTENT_TRANSPORT: The source only transports PartyId in an authenticated request/response or transient UI state; it has no persisted reference to transfer.
